attributes.title: SE SCALI 2027: Collaborating for Student Success
attributes.series: Southeast School Counselor and Administrator Leadership Institute (SE SCALI)
attributes.summary:
The Southeast School Counselor and Administrator Leadership Institute runs February 21 and 22, 2027, at the Renaissance Orlando at SeaWorld. The institute is built for school counselors and the principals and district leaders they work with, and the 2027 theme is "Collaborating for Student Success." John Hodge gives the February 22 keynote, "Be the ONE!", and also leads a breakout on resilience.

Unlike the larger state association conferences, SE SCALI is a compact two-day format centered on extended workshop sessions, which are included in the registration price. The institute is organized by the National Center for Youth Issues, which also manages a number of state school counselor association conferences.

Registration is $200 through January 15, 2027, and $225 after that until the advance deadline of February 17. Refunds end January 21. The hotel block is $249 per night plus a $20 resort fee until February 1. The page does not list CE or NBCC hours, so counselors who need credit for a license should confirm with the organizer.
